title: Person
description: Institution-local educational identity, independent of credentials.

created_at.description: UTC instant of initial durable creation. Server assigned.

version.description: Starts at 1. Increment exactly once per authoritative mutation.

updated_at.description: UTC instant of the latest authoritative mutation. Server assigned.

display_name.description: Current approved name used in LMS views.

legal_name_ref.description: Protected reference to legal-name evidence. Present only where institutional records require it.

learner_number.description: Optional institution-issued academic identifier. Unique among all historical non-null values.

age_status.description: Restricted policy result. It carries no birth date.

state.description: Current lifecycle state. Mutate only through declared transitions.

x-invariants: No automatic cross-institution deduplication. A name or email never proves identity.
Pseudonymization preserves the surrogate identity and protected official records to the extent policy requires.
Restricted state blocks interactive academic access except purpose-specific records workflows.
